name: Asao Seiji
source:
A student at Nishinazaka Gakuen, Class 3-7. Seiji is in love with his classmate Kanno Riri. He is a young looking guy who as his appearance suggests, is still immature and tends to dream.

[Translated from [url=http://www.lunasys.info/cate_lunasystem/product]official website[/url].]
